column1: #  This is the data source for scripts/list_templates.{sh,ps1} and for
#  companion and carries the full provenance and the quality scores.
#    id  format  venue  template  version  year  origin  license  path  source  state
#    - official       : published by the venue/publisher itself
#    - typst-official : published by the Typst project (not a venue endorsement)
#    - community      : third-party reimplementation of a venue's look
#  A row whose path is reports/<id>, or the generic-typst draft, is a LAYERED
#  document BY REGISTRATION: scripts/new_typst_paper.{sh,ps1} scaffolds it with a
#  and pre-checks starter/{main.typ,meta.typ,content/} — a missing starter is a
#  hard failure, never a fallback to a venue entry. Daily entries:
#  chinese-research (调研综述), modern-technical (工程技术文档), generic-typst
#  (paper draft, no target yet). Everything else is a venue paper and needs its
#  A TAB-separated file is deliberate: it is trivially readable from both bash
#  and PowerShell without a JSON parser, and diffable in git.
